steps.npc: Greetings, how may I be of service.

options.text: Who are you? What is your name?

steps.player: Who are you? What is your name?

steps.npc: Who am I?
I am whatever is needed of me.
I am a form undefined by natural laws, manifested by someone we mustn't speak of.
I'm a clay doll, shaped by a sculptor. Never allowed to set, forever malleable. But maybe, not for long...
My true name is immaterial, But you may call me...
Let's see now, what would be most appropriate?
Ah, yes.
You may call me The Sage.

steps.player: Uhhh, ok... Sage. Where did you bring us?

steps.npc: 'Where' is the right question my friend, but maybe not in the way you are accustomed to hearing.
Reality as you know it has many layers, all slightly different with their own rules.
Through the power granted to me, I brought us to this layer using the River-Between. The River of Souls.
We now stand on the stage of what is yet to be your most entertaining performance yet!

steps.player: Layers? River-Between? What does any of this mean?

steps.npc: To give everything away at this point would be unwise, considering we are being watched even now. You should only be concerned about one thing.
Being entertaining.
That's the only way you will get out of this event alive...

steps.player: Entertaining? What are you talking about? Who am I entertaining? Stop talking in riddles!

steps.npc: Ahh, [player name], please forgive me. In my attempts to explain, I appear to have confused you even further...
I will keep things simple for you; Participate in this event and you will continue to exist. Refusal to participate will end in your eventual destruction.
The choice is yours... hero.

steps.player: Well, that doesn't really answer anything...

steps.npc: Worry not. I have much grander plans for you yet, but like all good stories we must wait for the right time and place...

options.text: You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?

steps.player: You mentioned other Leagues - how does this differ from those?

steps.npc: Like all events before it, the rules of the world have been altered to be more entertaining for those who are watching.
The biggest change has been to the Relics from the previous chapter.
These objects of power are now gone, I have broken them into Fragments and spread across this iteration of the world.
When multiple Fragments are in harmony, they can be used together to create powerful effects.

steps.player: Yes, I remember you shattering them on the boat ride.
So I have Fragments to collect... got it. Are there any OTHER weird rules I should know about?

steps.npc: I understand that in previous Leagues, they limited you to smaller spaces of your world.
That restriction doesn't exist in this event.
You're free to roam your world, exploring the furthest reaches from Morytania to Kourend & Kebos.
But there's a catch.

steps.player: Oh great... there's always a catch.

steps.npc: I've limited and reset some of your memories, meaning you won't be able to interact with certain elements of this world.
For example, you'll only have access to three skills: Defence, Fishing and Thieving, as well as the Combat Class you chose earlier.
In order to gain access to other skills, you need to complete Tasks for me.
Doing so gives you Sage's Renown. A rather fitting name, I thought.
With Renown you can purchase access to new skills as well as bosses and quests.

steps.player: Why are you doing all of this? Surely I'd be more 'entertaining' if I could have all the power at once?

steps.npc: I can't just give you all that power. What kind of story starts the hero with all the power they want?
No, your story needs good rhythm. A sort of cadence that makes things interesting for your audience.
Start slow, work your way up. Become the hero you were always meant to be...
Once you have proven yourself, then and only then will you earn my renown.
That's how you provide good entertainment my friend...
That's how you make a hero.

steps.player: I suppose you're right...

steps.npc: Do you desire more information?

steps.player: Yes, please.
Not right now.

steps.npc: Go forward and continue your journey.
Remember, we are always watching...

options.text: Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?

steps.player: Any tips you can give me on being 'entertaining'?

steps.npc: I have devised a number of tasks to help keep your story on track.
Each task has a level of difficulty: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite and Master.
The more tasks you complete, the more activities you can unlock.
The more content you unlock the more interesting your story will become.
The more interesting the story the more entertained the ones watching will be.
Not only that, completing tasks also earns you League Points. The number of points earned is dependent on the difficulty of the task.

steps.player: What do I use these 'points' on?

steps.npc: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Fragment Slot.
These slots allow you to equip more Fragments and become even stronger.
League Points can also be used to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can access your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. The world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.player: So how many tasks are there?

steps.npc: More than you'll ever be able to complete, given our limited time here.
With so many to choose from, it's up to you to decide how your story plays out...

steps.player: Ok... I think I understand what I should do now.

steps.npc: Very good. I knew I made the right choice bringing you to this chapter.

steps.player: What is a Fragment?

steps.npc: You remember the Relics from the previous event, yes? The sources of great power that let you achieve amazing feats.
Fragments are similar. As the Fragments were created from the Relics, much of their power remains but in a much-diminished form.
They bestow many different bonuses: from helping you cut wood, to making you a more formidable warrior.
Equipping Fragments will grant you their power.
You can also level up your Fragments, making them even MORE powerful.
Gaining experience as you normally would will level up your Fragments, making them even more useful.

steps.player: How do I find these Fragments?

steps.npc: I have scattered the Fragments evenly across the world.
Anytime you kill a monster or gain more experience in a particular skill, you'll have a chance to receive a Fragment.
The harder the enemy or activity, the better chance you'll have.
You will only receive Fragments relevant to the activity, with a few exceptions.
I know your kind enjoy seeking out treasure. Fragments related to Treasure Trails can come from anywhere.

steps.player: What happens if I try to put the Fragments back together?

steps.npc: As I said, the Fragments still contain some of their residual Relic energy.
When enough Fragments are brought back together they will emit the same energy they did when they were whole.
For example, if you find five Fragments imbued with Last Recall, you can complete the set and gain access to that Relic's full power.
A sort of 'Set Effect' if you will.
Is there anything else you wish to know?

options.text: How does the content unlock system work?

steps.player: How does the content unlock system work?

steps.npc: In this iteration of the event I have limited you, at first, to three skills: Thieving, Fishing and Defence.
You can still do simple things like cut trees or mine ore, but doing so will be fruitless, as no experience will be gained.
In order to gain experience in these skills, you'll need to unlock them by using my Renown.
You gain renown by being entertaining, by completing tasks. The amount of Renown you earn depends on the difficulty of the task.
When it comes to exceptionally strong creatures, you'll need to unlock the ability to fight them. You can see all locked creatures by opening the unlock interface.
One final morsal of information you might be interested in. I understand that in previous Leagues you were forced to complete certain 'Quests' in their entirety.

If you wish, you may spend Sage's Renown to skip through these Quests while still gaining any final rewards. However, be warned thaat I will not offer any gifts to you if you finish these quests by yourself.
You should also know that by completing quests with Sage's Renown, you will not earn any final experience like you would if you finished the quest yourself.
Is there anything else you wish to know.

options.text: How did I get here again?

steps.player: How did I get here again?

steps.npc: I can retell the story, if you wish me to.

steps.player: Yes, please.
Not right now.

steps.npc: So be it.

options.text: Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?

steps.player: Will I be rewarded for participating in this event?

steps.npc: As you progress you'll earn League Points, which will unlock new slots and allow you to equip more Fragments.
However, when our time in this world is over, you can spend your League Points to buy rewards from the Leagues Reward Shop.
Of course, the real reward for participating will be my master and I sparing your life once the event ends...

steps.player: Are there any other rewards I can earn from this event?

steps.npc: I see...
In my time on the River of Souls I have found that when chapters are concluded their collapsing can be... incomplete.
Therefore, certain items can slip through the cracks, so to say.
In fact, it's through one of these cracks that I was able to save you from the previous chapter's collapse.
I collect these lost items from other worlds and keep them with me, should I ever need them one day.
I'm happy to offer them as an incentive for playing your part in this event.
The first item is a powerful whip.
It is imbued with the energy of thousands of lost souls, forever trapped in the bondage of their iron chains.
Each crack releases a deafening howl from the screams of its victims trapped within...
The next item is a cannon.
It's poweered by channelled arcane energy, each explosion teleported into the barrel from a border dimension.
Using a power unknwon, it expels shrapnel that tears through flesh and souls alike.
There are others of course. You'll be free to trade these rewards to others in your world, or you can keep them. It doesn't matter to me.

steps.player: I see. That all sounds good to me.

steps.text: Right now, you are playing on your Leagues profile. The Leagues Reward Shop can only be opened on your main profile.
You can acess your main profile by switching to any normal Old School RuneScape world. Using world switcher in the logout menu can be used to switch worlds.

steps.npc: And hero, beware - the Shattered Relic rewards won't be available until the League has ended. You can still buy rewards from previous Leagues, however.
Now, alongside the rewards in the Leagues Reward Shop, there's also League Ranks.

steps.player: League Ranks? How do they work?

steps.npc: At the end of the League, you will be judged and given a rank. This is based upon the number of League Points you have earned compared to the other participants.
Anyone who earns at least 100 League Points will be eligible for the Bronze rank. The top 80% of participants get the Iron rank. The top 60% get Steel.
The top 40% get Mithril. The top 20% get Adamant. The top 5% get Rune. The best participants, those who make it to the top 1%, get the Dragon rank!
When the League ends, you'll get a trophy based on your rank. These trophies symbolise your performance in the League.
You'll also get League-to-League rewards based on your League Rank.
League Starter Outfits and League Icons are some of things you can unlock for the next League. Also, any pets you earn in this League will transfer over to the next one.
Finally, I plan to recognise the first heroes to complete particular activities.
You can view the entire list of activities, as well as whether or not someone has completed them, on the board beside me.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.npc: Is there anything else you wish to know?

steps.player: Let's talk about pets.
Can you tell me how pets work in Leagues?

steps.npc: Of course! If you're lucky enough to obtain a pet during a League, it will automatically be insured for you.
This means that if you were to ever lose it, you can talk to me and I'll give it back to you. Insurance and reclaiming is all free!
Additionally, each pet you obtain will be transferred to the next League. It'll be waiting with me for you to reclaim it!

steps.player: Okay! Thank you.

steps.npc: Return to me once you have some pets and you'll be able to view your collection. Is there anything else you wish to know?

options.text: Do I have any League items to collect?

steps.player: Do I have any items to collect?

steps.text: If the player does not have any items to collect:

steps.npc: It doesn't look like you need any League items right now. I'll be here if you ever do.

steps.text: If the player has an item to collect from The Sage:
You receive an item from the Sage.

steps.player: I'm good, thanks.

steps.npc: Very well. I'll be here if you ever need to know anything about Leagues.
